description: Read-capability but POSTs an object-url request. The verb is pinned to GET by body_constant, so no method argument exists and none of these cases can send one. Pins the region/label/name-required rejections, both edges of the published expires_in window (360 to 3600) with the value the caller sent named back, and the success POST body. expires_in is deferred to the API's documented default (3600): omitted from the body unless the caller provides it. No content_type: the page scopes that member to the verbs other than GET and DELETE.

cases.name: rejects an expires_in below the signing floor
cases.expect_error: expires_in must be between 360 and 3600 seconds, got 359

cases.name: rejects an expires_in above the signing ceiling
cases.expect_error: expires_in must be between 360 and 3600 seconds, got 3601

cases.name: mints a download URL with the API default expiry
rejects a bare-array API response
cases.expect_api_error: object storage object download url create response must be a JSON object
